Method of Attack: Trojanized IM app containing BadBazaar spyware; targets contact lists, call logs, Google Accounts, WiFi data; offers backup feature sending Telegram communication data to attacker-controlled server
Impacted Systems: Users in Ukraine, Poland, the Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Germany, Hong Kong, United States
Attack Vector: Trojanized app uploaded to Google Play
Dedicated website flygram[.]org offering app installation links
